verdict.rationale: Evidence shows release notes and beta/alpha-labeled features (e.g., 'VM Sandboxes Beta', 'Sidecars Alpha', experimental snapshot API), but there is no documented versioning scheme or deprecation policy for the API; the OpenAPI spec probe also 404'd, showing no formal API contract surfaced. No mention of semantic versioning, deprecation timelines, or backward-compatibility guarantees anywhere in the pack.
